indira-awas-yojana.notice: Indira Awas Yojana (IAY) was restructured and upgraded into PMAY-G in 2016. Financial assistance was enhanced up to ₹1.20 Lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 Lakh in hilly/difficult regions, with Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

nirmal-bharat-abhiyan.notice: Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan was restructured into the nationwide Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) in 2014, providing ₹12,000 financial incentive for individual household latrines (IHHL).

rajiv-gandhi-scheme-for-empowerment-of-a.legacy_name: Rajiv Gandhi Scheme for Empowerment of Adolescent Girls (SABLA)
rajiv-gandhi-scheme-for-empowerment-of-a.successor_name: Scheme For Adolescent Girls (Mission Shakti - SAMBAL)
rajiv-gandhi-scheme-for-empowerment-of-a.notice: SABLA has been restructured and integrated under the comprehensive Mission Shakti (SAMBAL) framework as the Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG), focusing on nutrition, iron supplements, and vocational life-skills.

national-optical-fibre-network.notice: NOFN was rebranded and significantly expanded as BharatNet under Digital India, delivering 100 Mbps broadband connectivity to all 2.5 Lakh Gram Panchayats across India.

rajiv-gandhi-grameen-vidyutikaran-yojana.successor_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY)
rajiv-gandhi-grameen-vidyutikaran-yojana.notice: RGGVY was subsumed into DDUGJY to ensure 24x7 power supply to rural households and feeder separation for agricultural and non-agricultural rural consumers.

swarnajayanti-gram-swarozgar-yojana.successor_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
swarnajayanti-gram-swarozgar-yojana.notice: SGSY was restructured into DAY-NRLM (Aajeevika) to organize rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and provide continuous revolving funds and credit linkage.

swarna-jayanti-shahari-rozgar-yojana.successor_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
swarna-jayanti-shahari-rozgar-yojana.notice: SJSRY was restructured into DAY-NULM to address urban poverty, skill development, micro-enterprise credit, and shelters for urban homeless.

jawaharlal-nehru-national-urban-renewal-.legacy_name: Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission (JnNURM)
jawaharlal-nehru-national-urban-renewal-.successor_name: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT 2.0)
jawaharlal-nehru-national-urban-renewal-.notice: JnNURM was succeeded by AMRUT to establish universal tap water coverage, sewerage management, and stormwater drainage in 500 major cities.

rashtriya-swasthya-bima-yojana.successor_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
rashtriya-swasthya-bima-yojana.notice: RSBY (which offered ₹30,000 coverage) was superseded by Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, offering ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor families.

national-agricultural-insurance-scheme.notice: NAIS and Modified NAIS were replaced by PMFBY, establishing uniform low farmer premiums (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops) with full non-capped sum insured coverage.
